risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with VIX in crisis territory (344.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar headwind for financials, and recent CPI miss; earnings 91 days out provides minimal near-term protection.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD crossover, RSI21 bullish, and Supertrend bullish signals combined with extreme fear (34/100) contrarian opportunity suggest potential momentum initiation before broader recovery.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA with Ichimoku bearish cloud, zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis conditions, unfavorable macro environment, and no triggered strategies despite signal activity indicate insufficient conviction for swing entry.
